kit_page.name: image_kit
kit_page.summary: Tone mapper, sharpen, colour grade, split tone, vignette, film grain and lens CA: the look of the shot.

kit_row.help: Which curve maps bright scene light to the screen. AMD LPM is the default. Home: Exposure > Tone mapper.
kit_row.label: Tonemapper

kit_row.help: Overall brightness, applied through the tonemapper. Home: Exposure > Exposure.
kit_row.label: Exposure

kit_row.help: Runs the full chain on skies with probe ambiance 0 too. May look more contrasty. Home: Exposure > Legacy gamma.
kit_row.label: Legacy skies

kit_row.help: AMD LPM only: stops between HDR max and the 18 percent mid level. Home: Exposure > AMD exposure.
kit_row.label: Tone exposure

kit_row.help: Exposure offset in stops, applied before the log curve. Home: Exposure > S-Log EV.
kit_row.label: EV offset

kit_row.help: Post-tonemap saturation for every operator. 1 is neutral; lower flattens for grading.
kit_row.label: Saturation

kit_row.help: Post-tonemap contrast around mid grey. 1 is neutral.
kit_row.label: Contrast

kit_row.help: Scene light, camera exposure and auto-exposure live on the Exposure page.
kit_row.label: Exposure

kit_row.help: Sets the tone sliders on this page back to their defaults.
kit_row.label: Reset tone

kit_row.help: Opens the one-stop Exposure floater with the same settings.
kit_row.label: Exposure hub

kit_row.help: Edge-aware sharpening. Keep it low or 0 for log capture and sharpen in the grade.
kit_row.label: Sharpen (CAS)

kit_row.help: Turns the colour grade on. The LUT and grade sliders apply only when it is on.
kit_row.label: Colour grade

kit_row.help: Colour lookup table applied after the tonemapper. Includes built-ins and files found in your user colorlut folder.
kit_row.label: LUT

kit_row.help: How strongly the LUT is applied. 1 is full.
kit_row.label: LUT strength

kit_row.help: Shifts white balance in Kelvin: negative warms, positive cools. 0 is neutral daylight.
kit_row.label: Temperature

kit_row.help: Green (positive) or magenta (negative) tint, across the temperature axis.
kit_row.label: Tint

kit_row.help: Raises or tints the shadows, per channel R G B. Negative crushes toward black.
kit_row.label: Lift

kit_row.help: Midtone gamma per channel. Below 1 brightens the mids, above 1 darkens them.
kit_row.label: Gamma

kit_row.help: Grade has no Lightbox page; this opens the Lightbox Image tab where the other tone controls live.
kit_row.label: Lightbox ›

kit_row.help: Highlight gain per channel. Boosts, clips or tints the whites.
kit_row.label: Gain

kit_row.help: Shifts the whole grade lighter or darker. Small values, about 0.05, are already visible.
kit_row.label: Grade bright

kit_row.help: S-curve around mid grey. Below 1 flattens to a matte look; above 1.3 starts to clip.
kit_row.label: Grade contrast

kit_row.help: Uniform grade saturation. 0 is black and white; 1.5 is heavily stylised.
kit_row.label: Grade sat

kit_row.help: Pushes muted colours harder than saturated ones. 0.3 is a subtle skin-friendly lift.
kit_row.label: Vibrance

kit_row.help: Recovers (negative) or boosts (positive) highlights without touching the mids. -0.3 pulls back blown skies.
kit_row.label: Highlights

kit_row.help: Lifts (positive) or crushes (negative) shadows without touching the mids.
kit_row.label: Shadows

kit_row.help: Crushes values at or below this level to black. 0.05 deepens blacks cinematically.
kit_row.label: Black point

kit_row.help: Clips values at or above this level to white. 0.95 blooms highlights; 0.9 gives a bleach-bypass look.
kit_row.label: White point

kit_row.help: Rotates every hue around the wheel in degrees. 30 warms everything; 180 inverts.
kit_row.label: Hue shift

kit_row.help: Filmic curve toe per channel. Values at or below it flatten toward black.
kit_row.label: Curve toe

kit_row.help: Filmic curve shoulder per channel. Around 0.85 gives a tighter roll-off.
kit_row.label: Curve shoulder

kit_row.help: Blend strength of the curve per channel. 0 is off; 0.4 is a typical film curve.
kit_row.label: Curve amount

kit_row.help: Strength of the shadow and highlight tints. 0 is off; about 0.5 is a natural push.
kit_row.label: Split tone

kit_row.help: Slides the midpoint between shadow and highlight tints. Negative widens shadows; positive widens highlights.
kit_row.label: Balance

kit_row.help: Target colour for the shadows. Grey is neutral; a cool teal gives the classic teal-and-orange look.
kit_row.label: Shadow tint

kit_row.help: Target colour for the highlights. Grey is neutral; warm amber complements teal shadows.
kit_row.label: Highlight tint

kit_row.help: Midtone tint strength, separate from shadows and highlights. 0.15 to 0.35 adds mood without muddying skin.
kit_row.label: Midtone amt

kit_row.help: Target colour for the midtones. A warm tint such as 0.55, 0.5, 0.45 flatters skin.
kit_row.label: Midtone tint

kit_row.help: How dark the frame edges get. 0 is off.
kit_row.label: Amount

kit_row.help: Size of the clear centre, in image-height units. 1 reaches the top and bottom edges.
kit_row.label: Radius

kit_row.help: Shape of the darkening from edge to centre. Lower spreads it inward as a gentle haze.
kit_row.label: Feather

kit_row.help: Softness of the vignette edge.
kit_row.label: Edge soft

kit_row.help: Colour the vignette fades into at the edges.
kit_row.label: Edge colour

kit_row.help: Where the three-colour ramp's middle colour sits. 0 uses the two-colour fallback.
kit_row.label: Mid point

kit_row.help: Middle colour of the three-colour vignette ramp.
kit_row.label: Mid colour

kit_row.help: 0 is a circular vignette; 1 is a rounded square.
kit_row.label: Shape

kit_row.help: Offset of the vignette centre, X and Y.
kit_row.label: Centre

kit_row.help: Corrects the vignette for the frame aspect ratio.
kit_row.label: Fix aspect

kit_row.help: Strength of the film grain. 0 is off.
kit_row.label: Amount

kit_row.help: Size of the grain particles. Larger reads as coarser film.
kit_row.label: Size

kit_row.help: Where grain peaks in brightness: 0 shadows, 0.5 midtones (classic film), 1 highlights.
kit_row.label: Range

kit_row.help: Grain character: mono luma, colour digital, coarse 16mm, or CCD photon shot.
kit_row.label: Style

kit_row.help: Animates the grain between frames.
kit_row.label: Animated

kit_row.help: Grain colour. White is neutral grey; warm or cool tints mimic film or video noise.
kit_row.label: Tint

kit_row.help: Colour fringing toward the frame edges, like a cinema lens. About 0.15 is subtle; 0 is off.
kit_row.label: Strength

kit_row.help: How fast the fringing grows from centre to edge. Higher keeps the centre clean.
kit_row.label: Falloff

kit_row.help: Direction of the red-blue split in degrees. Positive and negative Stretch choose opposite axes.
kit_row.label: Angle deg

kit_row.help: Stretches the fringe along the angle for an anamorphic smear.
kit_row.label: Stretch

kit_row.help: Horizontal direction of the red channel shift. -1 moves red inward.
kit_row.label: Red X

kit_row.help: Vertical direction of the red channel shift.
kit_row.label: Red Y

kit_row.help: Horizontal direction of the blue channel shift. Usually opposite the red.
kit_row.label: Blue X

kit_row.help: Vertical direction of the blue channel shift.
kit_row.label: Blue Y

kit_row.help: Khronos Neutral only: how hard highlights roll toward white. Higher is flatter, like LPM.
kit_row.label: Desaturate

kit_row.help: Khronos Neutral only: where highlight compression starts. Lower compresses more of the range.
kit_row.label: Knee

kit_row.help: AMD LPM only: the maximum input value the curve accepts.
kit_row.label: HDR max

kit_row.help: AMD LPM only: extra contrast from 0 (none) to 1 (maximum).
kit_row.label: LPM contrast

kit_row.help: AMD LPM only: red saturation. Negative decreases, positive increases.
kit_row.label: Red sat

kit_row.help: AMD LPM only: green saturation. Negative decreases, positive increases.
kit_row.label: Green sat

kit_row.help: AMD LPM only: blue saturation. Negative decreases, positive increases.
kit_row.label: Blue sat

kit_row.help: S-Log3 capture only: which log curve to encode. Grade with the matching transform.
kit_row.label: Log curve

kit_row.help: Full or Legal (video) code range. Must match the grade's data levels.
kit_row.label: Range

kit_row.help: Shadow toe lift for 8-bit shadow protection. 0 is off. Needs a matching inverse in the grade.
kit_row.label: Shadow toe

kit_row.help: Graduated ND, Polarizer, Infrared and Soft edge live on the Lens Filters page.
kit_row.label: Lens filters

kit_row.help: Opens the full Lightbox Image tab.
kit_row.label: Lightbox ›
